subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new public `deferred` cron/run status plus plugin-facing lifecycle callback/SDK exports as the permanent yielded-parent handoff contract?
rationale: The code may be a plausible fix, but it expands persisted protocol, CLI/UI, hook, and Plugin SDK surfaces; automation cannot decide that public compatibility contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Require a clean rebase, Discord-visible proof, upgrade compatibility proof, and maintainer signoff before merging the public `deferred` and lifecycle SDK surfaces.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Ask for a narrower implementation that fixes cron/Discord runtime behavior without adding new public status or SDK/hook surface until the contract is designed separately.

options.title: Defer to smaller fixes
options.body: Pause or close this broad branch if maintainers prefer landing the narrower related PRs and tracking the broader fan-in contract in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Require a clean rebase, Discord-visible proof, upgrade compatibility proof, and maintainer signoff before merging the public `deferred` and lifecycle SDK surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron/protocol/session and SDK-adjacent history makes this the best available routing owner for the public contract decision.
